summary.level_note: dBFS is relative to this recording, not calibrated sound pressure level.
summary.interpretation: Audio snore estimate only; this is not a medical severity score.
summary.cough_score_note: Cough scores are review hints, not validated cough counts.
summary.activity_gate_note: Experimental local activity gate on boundary cells and their 100 ms parent: max(-60, P20 + min(6, (P95-P20)/2)) dBFS over finite cells >= -80 dBFS. May miss soft snoring; not a breathing classifier.
summary.cough_review_note: Threshold selected on prompted Coswara clips; do not use it to count coughs in sleep recordings.

config.frequency_method: mean-removed Hann rFFT magnitude; DC excluded; next-power-of-two padding
config.rhythm_method: consecutive snoring-segment start intervals; population std
config.pitch_method: normalized autocorrelation; 80 ms frames, 40 ms hop; 50–1000 Hz; confidence >= 0.6

rhythm_autocorrelation.method: normalized autocorrelation of 10 Hz RMS envelope inside snoring-positive windows

sound_review.note: Overlapping review segments, not clinical event counts. Speech is not proof of sleep talking. Unflagged sound is unclassified, not normal breathing. Scores are not calibrated confidence.

breathing_rate.note: Experimental envelope-cycle estimate on breathing-like audio only; not validated respiratory rate. Missing values mean abstention, never zero breaths or apnea. Regular machine noise may fool this estimator. Snore intervals and pitch are not converted to breathing rate.

apnea_research.reason: No sleep-study-labeled audio model has been trained
